description: Current wave height and period at a coordinate (Open-Meteo Marine), and, when a US NOAA tide station id is given, the next high and low tide predictions for the next 24 hours. Tide predictions exist only for NOAA stations; no wind or pressure forecast is included. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

station.description: Optional NOAA tide station id (7 digits), e.g. 9413450 (Monterey)
